messages:
Maya (Security): Hey team — quick sync on SOC2 evidence for KMS/HSM + audit logs. Goal: get a staging evidence bundle ready by 2026-03-10. We need three things: 1) audit-log ingest proof (pipeline run + sample logs), 2) KMS key policy + rotation proof, 3) HSM vendor attestation (PDF). Proposed owners: Ravi -> auditlog pipeline + bucket proof, Sofia -> sample logs/schema, Tom -> upload script + manifest. @Ravi @Sofia @Tom any blockers?

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Not blocked, but two notes: (a) the current ingest worker PR is behind review (PR #8421), still needs a small fix for idempotency, (b) I need the exact retention requirement so I can show the S3 lifecycle policy. I can produce a signed URL and an MD5 manifest once PR merges.

Sofia (Eng-ML): I'll assemble sample logs and a short generator script. Example log snippet we'll include:

```json
{
  "ts": "2026-03-01T12:02:34Z",
  "req_id": "r-0a1b2c3d",
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "event": "token_emit",
  "latency_ms": 42
}
```

Sofia (Eng-ML): Quick Q for security: do we need schema versioning in the evidence or is one representative sample OK?

Maya (Security): One representative sample is OK but include a short note about schema fields and a pointer to the schema file. Retention: 365 days for this control. Please include the lifecycle JSON snippet or the S3 policy name.

Tom (DevEx): I'll own upload automation. Plan: a small script that zips evidence, uploads to s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/staging/<org>-soc2/2026-03-10/ and writes a manifest.json with checksums. Example I will use:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
zip -r evidence.zip ./evidence_dir
aws s3 cp evidence.zip s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/staging/$ORG/$DATE/evidence.zip --acl bucket-owner-full-control
sha256sum evidence.zip > manifest.sha256
aws s3 cp manifest.sha256 s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/staging/$ORG/$DATE/
```

Tom (DevEx): I can also add a tiny GH Actions job to run the upload once PRs are merged.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): PR #8421 is ready for one more review, flagged @Tom for the test infra change. Also the bucket path for evidence will be `s3://redwood-soc2-evidence/staging/maya-team/` — Tom, can you use that path?

Tom (DevEx): Yep, will use that path. Will tag upload artifacts with `x-compliance-evidence: soc2-2026-03` metadata.

Jordan (Product): Just to confirm scope: this bundle covers only inference audit logs + KMS/HSM key management for model serving, right? No customer PII traces expected in these logs?

Sofia (Eng-ML): Correct — logs will be truncated/user-ids hashed. I'll include a note describing the redaction step.

AuditBot: Created ticket COMPL-4567: "SOC2: staging evidence bundle preparation" and assigned to Maya, Ravi, Sofia, Tom. Link: https://issues.redwood.example/COMPL-4567

Maya (Security): Thanks — action items: Ravi -> merge PR #8421 and produce signed S3 URL + lifecycle policy snippet by 2026-03-05; Sofia -> upload sample logs + schema doc by 2026-03-06; Tom -> upload script + GH Action by 2026-03-08; I'll collect the HSM attestation from vendor and add to the bucket by 2026-03-09. If any date slips, call it out here.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): Ack, will push for merge today. @Tom I'll ping you on the PR for the infra test.

Tom (DevEx): ack :thumbsup:

Sofia (Eng-ML): ack, will post sample logs in the thread when done.

Maya (Security): Small formatting note: please follow the evidence template at /docs/compliance/evidence-template.md and name files: `manifest.json`, `sample-logs.json`, `kms-policy.txt`, `hsm-attestation.pdf`. That makes audit reviewer ingestion trivial.

Ravi (Eng-Infra): noted. Also added a short lifecycle snippet to the PR description:

```json
{"Rules": [{"ID": "soc2-retention-365", "Status": "Enabled", "Expiration": {"Days": 365}}]}
```

Jordan (Product): Thanks everyone — let me know if this impacts the rollout plan.

Maya (Security): Final ask: please react with :white_check_mark: when you complete your item so I can close COMPL-4567 in the tracker.

Tom (DevEx): :white_check_mark: 

Ravi (Eng-Infra): :white_check_mark: after merge (will update ticket)

Sofia (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: when sample logs posted

Maya (Security): Thanks all — leaving this thread open for uploads and checks.
